subject: Mutual plan: legal owners, redlines & turnaround (next steps)
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Brooks <kate.brooks@lumenedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP draft (owners & timeline)

Hi Kate — thanks again for the call earlier today. Per our conversation I’m attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures milestones, owners, and dependencies. High level:

- Milestone A: Pilot setup (LumenEdge / Redwood infra) — target 8/2/2026 — owner: LumenEdge
- Milestone B: Security & legal clearance (MSA/DPA/SLA redlines) — target 7/28/2026 — owner: Legal teams (see proposed split below)
- Milestone C: Pilot run & evaluation — target 8/16/2026 — owner: LumenEdge + Redwood CS

Key ask for legal: can your counsel take first pass redlines on the MSA + DPA by EOD 7/19? Redwood legal (cc’d) will then consolidate and aim to return edits within 3 business days. If that TAT looks tight for your side, let us know an alternate.

I’ve attached a PDF MAP ("20260712-LumenEdge-MAP-draft.pdf") and included a shared Drive link. Next steps I propose:
1) LumenEdge legal gives first-pass redlines or an ETA by 7/19
2) Redwood consolidates and sends counter-redlines by 7/22 (3 business days)
3) Finalize MSA/DPA SLA terms by 7/28 so we can keep the pilot on 8/2

Thanks — I’ll block time for a legal sync if helpful.

Best,
Dev Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: 20260712-LumenEdge-MAP-draft.pdf (MAP summary)
From: Kate Brooks <kate.brooks@lumenedge.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumenEdge Legal <legal@lumenedge.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (owners & timeline)

Dev — appreciate the clear plan and the draft MAP. Quick notes from our side after discussing with our procurement lead:

- We want to review the MAP milestones in parallel but legal will need to own the MSA/DPA redlines. I looped in our internal counsel (legal@lumenedge.com) so they can triage.
- 7/19 first-pass is probably doable, but our legal is out Weds morning for a conference; they said they can start redlines on 7/16 and send something by COB 7/19 if nothing urgent blocks them.
- On turnaround: their standard expectation is 5 business days for a substantive counter from a vendor for standard MSA edits. If Redwood can commit to 3 bd, that would be faster than our usual cadence and helpful.

Can your legal point person confirm they can do 3 business days after they receive our first pass? Also, we’d like the MAP to explicitly call out who owns SLA edit proposals vs. who signs final SLA appendices.

Thanks — Kate
Kate Brooks
Head of Cloud Partnerships, LumenEdge
kate.brooks@lumenedge.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Kate Brooks <kate.brooks@lumenedge.com>, LumenEdge Legal <legal@lumenedge.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recap + MAP draft (owners & timeline)

Thanks for loop, Dev / Kate. Internal ownership notes from Redwood legal/product:

- Redwood legal lead on this is Priyom Das (cc). Priyom will own vendor-side consolidation and will aim to return a redline package within 3 business days after receiving LumenEdge's first-pass.
- For clarity in the MAP:
  * "MSA (commercial/legal terms)" — primary owner: LumenEdge legal (first pass); Redwood legal (Priyom) will consolidate and propose final edits. TAT: 3 business days for Redwood turnaround.
  * "DPA (data handling & security)" — collaborative review: security/engineering (Redwood) + LumenEdge legal. We recommend one tracked doc for DPA to avoid version drift.
  * "SLA (availability/credits)" — Redwood to propose SLA appendix language; LumenEdge to review and propose counter-SLA requests. Owner: Redwood (draft), joint sign-off needed.

Dependencies/risks:
- If LumenEdge requests material commercial concessions (pricing caps, extended indemnities), we’ll need internal CRO + Legal approval which could add 5–7 business days.
- Any redlines that touch data residency or export controls will escalate to Security & Compliance and extend TAT (we should flag those early).

I’ll create a shared tracker and add milestone owners explicitly. Priyom — if you can confirm availability and the 3bd commitment, we’ll put that into the MAP and set the target close date at 7/28.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, GTM & Partnerships
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0144
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Brooks <kate.brooks@lumenedge.com>, LumenEdge Legal <legal@lumenedge.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recap + MAP draft (owners & timeline)

Confirmed — I’ll own Redwood-side consolidation. Operational notes:

- If we receive LumenEdge first-pass on or before COB 7/19, Redwood will return consolidated redlines by EOD 7/22 (3 business days).
- We will separate edits into three buckets in the returned package: "quick-accept" (minor language), "negotiable" (commercial/legal items), and "escalate" (requires CRO/Legal Exec). This will make it fast for LumenEdge to triage.
- Please send any compliance-specific asks (SOC2, audit logs, encryption KMS) in a single doc so Security can review in parallel. Security review may add 2–5 business days depending on scope.

Priyom Das
Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: LumenEdge Legal <legal@lumenedge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Brooks <kate.brooks@lumenedge.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Recap + MAP draft (owners & timeline)

Priyom / team — attaching our annotated redlines (attached: 20260720-LumenEdge-Redlines-annotated.docx).

Notes from counsel:
- We provided a tracked-change version of the MSA and a separate DPA with comments. Primary asks: clarification of data retention windows, limitation-of-liability caps, and a clearer SLA credits table.
- Our standard internal SLA review expects 5 business days for a vendor to push back with a final position; given your proposed 3bd TAT, we will do our best to respond faster but cannot guarantee earlier than 5bd on all points.
- If Redwood marks commercial concessions as "escalate", please flag who is the Redwood approver for expedited review.

Next steps per LumenEdge legal:
1) Redwood consolidates and sends vendor redline positions, with the three-bucket classification Priyom proposed.
2) For any escalated commercial asks, please route to Marissa and Dev for rapid decisioning.

Thanks,
LumenEdge Legal
legal@lumenedge.com

Attachments: 20260720-LumenEdge-Redlines-annotated.docx (MSA + DPA comments)
